title: Metering/budget record — the one frozen shape across the repo boundary
description: The single metering/budget record shape frozen before our budget adapter's receipt shape hardens into a third variant (issue #425). One record carries four groups: identity (which tenant/agent/run the row belongs to), quantity (the measured tokens/cost and the currency they are stated in), receipt (the per-task receipt that ties the row to a ticket), and attribution (the provider/model/tier/scope the row is charged against). Field names are the live vocabulary of telemetry/metering (UsageRecord.to_dict) and the budget rail — never invented. A record may also carry claims[]: an asserted cap or saving, each of which must name the evidence that measures it, so a claim that cannot be measured is refused rather than asserted. See docs/contracts/metering/README.md.

schemaVersion.description: The record-shape version. Bumping it is a contract change (a new file), never a silent extension.

kind.description: The record kind. A metering/budget row is exactly this kind; a second kind in this shape is a contract change.

identity.description: Which tenant, agent and run the row belongs to, and where it came from. tenantId/agentId are the metering store's attribution keys; runId is the run (session) that emitted the call; sourceType/sourceKey record which sibling record shape the row was absorbed from, so an absorbed row is never anonymous.

tenantId.description: The tenant the spend is attributed to (telemetry/metering tenantId).

agentId.description: The agent whose call this is (telemetry/metering agentId) — the agent-scope attribution key.

runId.description: The run/session identity that emitted the call (governance/isolation minted session id; the paperclip X-Paperclip-Run-Id on the peer side).

recordId.description: The row's own id (telemetry/metering recordId) — the record's identity, not authority-tracked.

sourceType.description: Which sibling record shape this row was absorbed from (telemetry/metering SOURCE_*).

sourceKey.description: The source record's key within its own shape (telemetry/metering sourceKey).

quantity.description: The measured quantity: real token counts, the resolved cost estimate and WHY it is trustworthy (costSource), and the currency both are stated in. costUsd is null — never 0 — when the cost could not be measured; metered/costSource/unmeteredReason carry the honesty of that null.

costUsd.description: Resolved cost in the stated currency (telemetry/metering costUsd). null means unmetered — deliberately unknown, never silently zero.

costSource.description: Why the cost figure is trustworthy (telemetry/metering COST_SOURCE_*): priced from a rate card, an attached positive estimate, or the explicit zero-cost cache-hit path. null = unmetered.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency of costUsd (fleet vendor caps are USD; the rail's declared currency).

metered.description: True when a cost was resolved; false means unmetered (fail closed — never a zero-cost call).

billable.description: True when the call is billable (telemetry/metering billable); non-billable outcomes carry no usage.

cacheHit.description: The explicit zero-cost cache-hit path (telemetry/metering cacheHit).

unmeteredReason.description: Why the row is unmetered (telemetry/metering unmeteredReason) — named, never dropped.

receipt.description: The receipt that ties the row to a ticket. receipt is the per-task receipt id; ticket is the ticket that funded the spend; evidence is the delivery evidence reference that backs the receipt — the same object style the ticket's evidence[] carries (#400/#401). An empty evidence reference is not a receipt, and the gate refuses it.

ticket.description: The ticket the spend is tied to (e.g. kushin77/agent-orchestrator#425).

receipt.description: The per-task receipt id (telemetry/budgets ledger receipt; upstream cost receipt).

evidence.description: The evidence reference backing the receipt (the ticket evidence[] ref / ledger entry). Must be non-empty — checked by the parity gate.

attribution.description: The attribution fields: which provider/model/tier produced the call, the routing outcome, and the budget scope the spend is charged against (the ticket facet's closed budget shape).

tier.description: The effective model tier (gateway finops chooser tier).

taskClass.description: The task class the chooser attributed the call to (gateway finops task_class).

outcome.description: The call outcome (telemetry/metering outcome; non-billable outcomes name a guard/policy decision).

scope.description: What the cap applies to (the ticket facet's budget.scope).

level.description: The scoping level of the cap.

id.description: The agent / team / project id the cap applies to.

period.description: The budget window (fleet: month — the vendor cap window in telemetry/budgets/budget.py).

cap.description: The spend limit for the period, in the stated currency.

spent.description: Spend already consumed in the period, in the stated currency.

hardStop.description: True when the cap is absolute: spend at or above it always stops with a graceful hand-off.

burnRateAlertPct.description: Burn-rate alert threshold, as a percentage of cap, that warns before the hard stop.

claims.description: An asserted cap or saving the row makes (a metering claim). Every claim must name the evidence field that measures it; the parity gate refuses a claim whose evidence is empty, so a saving or a cap that cannot be measured is not claimed.

kind.description: What is being claimed: a cap that was held, or a saving that was realised.

metric.description: The measured quantity the claim is about (e.g. costUsd, totalTokens).

value.description: The claimed value, in the metric's own unit.

evidence.description: The evidence that measures the claim (a receipt id, a ledger reference, a measurement). Must be non-empty — the gate refuses an empty one.
